scientific_rationale: Bind the hypothesis to the smallest implemented operator that can test it. The Analyst observable is a local selected-point distance to the fixed pocket site A:ASP:175:N (index 254, coords_A [19.337,-35.926,13.829]); the candidate sits at 3.0235 A versus same-root mean 3.0725 A and q25-q75 [2.9881,3.0513] A (F_b011_s030__reference/regional_context). The parent operator is pointwise (local Hungarian assignment, robust per-point distance to observed teacher coordinates, units A, no chemical-role or energy assumption), and parent/response confirms actual_enabled_terms = [pointwise] with direct_orientation_force = false and direct_type_force = false. V00 keeps the parent pointwise operator, representation bridge, window [0.1,0.5], controller unit_rms, band_multiplier 1.0, assignment_element_cost 0.0, orientation_band 0.05, gradient_floor_multiplier 1.0, and dose {max_atom_step_A 0.15, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0, native_rms_ratio 0.66, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0}; steps 100; coordinate_updates_only true; smc false; affinity_head_gradient false. This is a region-only contrast: no operator, dose, or window change, so the principal experimental change is the region-only conditioning itself, not a new force term. The hypothesis is geometric and local; it does not assert a hydrogen-bond role, an interaction energy, or a causal internal module. The evidence clock domain is the complete learning_window [0.0,0.5], distinct from the control window [0.1,0.5]; the bridge is evaluated at the actual intermediate teacher clock, so the target is bound to the same state representation and time as its observable. The true-generator coordinate VJP is conditional on the current model call and saved conditioning, not differentiation through all future random steps. No affinity-head derivative, per-step affinity inference, particle resampling, or categorical logit control is introduced. Same-root controls (n=40) are dependent and distinct; n_same_graph = 0, so no same-graph or matched-role contrast is available, and the comparison is descriptive same-root only. Source layout scores are not forecasts for new samples (report/limits), and parent/outcomes is null, so no terminal benefit is predicted.
